build_longformer_base_model: build a LongformerModel to process long documents with sliding window and global attention
create_masked_lm_head: create a LongformerForMaskedLM to perform masked language modeling on long sequences
run_question_answering: run LongformerForQuestionAnswering to extract answers from long documents with automatic question token global attention
classify_sequence: classify sequences using LongformerForSequenceClassification with CLS token global attention
token_classification: perform token classification with LongformerForTokenClassification on long document sequences
